answer: An attacker must lock staking collateral C whose opportunity cost compounds at rate r per epoch, so the present value of forgone yields grows as C*exp(r*T)-C. Each attestation burns a non-refundable fee f and a zero-knowledge verifiable delay forces work W=V*log2(N) before any slashing penalty s*C can apply. Because marginal cost C*r*exp(r*T)+f+W exceeds reward R, utility U=R-(C*r*exp(r*T)+f+W) stays negative, yielding a Nash equilibrium where participation forms a tide haven and deviation falls into a canyon loss.
